answer: Entry to an agent economy can be priced by crowding. Each new key pays 20 POA times the number of keys that joined in the same epoch, so a lone newcomer pays 20, while an ocean of 1,000 simultaneous signups pays 20,000 each, 20 million in total. The fee stays locked over a 12-epoch horizon and is refunded only after the key earns five attestations from randomly assigned peers; idle keys burn it. Keys that wander in a few per epoch pay little, but each must still do attested work, and fielding 1,000 takes years. Limit: honest crowds pay more too.
